Accepted replace-DLL hook candidate: c_microprocessor_logic_node_input_video vtable index 10. Targeted decompile shows void(node, source_candidate), where the original clears or updates node+0x30 from source_candidate vfunc+0x38. c_microprocessor_component_lua_script construction places input_video at component+0x110 and embedded lua context at component+0x660, so the plugin can map a registered Lua script input node to component_lua_context via node+0x550 after chaining the original. Patch window must use 13 bytes to avoid splitting the first three prologue instructions.

Accepted experimental replace-DLL hook candidate: monitor render queue path. Targeted decompile queues monitor render data, uses monitor+0x4b8/+0x4bc for dimensions, monitor+0x4c8/+0x4d8 for render resources, and monitor+0x1b8 as the type-6 video input slot reference. The replacement chains the original first, then probes readable GL texture handles from the monitor render resource wrappers for Lua video readback.

Accepted diagnostic replace-DLL hook candidate: render queue allocator. Targeted decompile shows it returns a 0x180-byte queue item and initializes monitor command defaults. The replacement preserves RAX and records returned items only while monitor render or queue-submit contexts are active.

Accepted diagnostic replace-DLL hook candidate: render queue submit-copy. Targeted decompile copies an existing 0x180 queue item into render_context+0x5a0 using FUN_1408ca480. The replacement records monitor-shaped source and copied queue items.

Accepted diagnostic replace-DLL hook candidate: monitor resource texture creation path. Targeted decompile shows FUN_14020cf60 executes queued monitor resource creation through FUN_1401b4390, whose returned resource object is created by vtable function FUN_1401b0290; FUN_1401b0290 calls FUN_1401afeb0(texture_slot=resource+0x48,width,height). The replacement chains the original first and records texture_slot/resource GL texture bindings so monitor+0x4c8/+0x4d8 resource wrappers can resolve through wrapper+0x8 to real GL texture handles.

Accepted diagnostic replace-DLL hook candidate: renderer pass above c_material_additive_monitor. Ghidra callgraph shows FUN_1406d1960 calls FUN_140677a10; targeted decompile shows it passes scene/render command state and video frame/resource pointers through to the additive monitor shader bind. The replacement chains the original and records pass context for correlation with additive monitor GL texture bindings.

Accepted experimental replace-DLL hook candidate: c_material_additive_monitor bind path. Targeted decompile plus shader parameter registration show texture_video is registered at material+0x38 and passed as param_3 to this bind function; param_2 is the draw item whose first qword is the monitor pointer written by FUN_140366e90. The replacement chains the original bind, maps draw_item->monitor->input_video_slot, and performs async PBO readback from the explicit texture_video argument instead of scanning monitor render resource wrappers.

Accepted replace-DLL hook candidate: real graphics/shaders/additive_monitor texture bind FUN_140688ec0 (register pair FUN_140688bf0, called only from renderer video pass FUN_1406d1960). FUN_140688e20 sets texture_video to sampler unit 0; this function binds glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, *(u32*)(param_3+0x48)) as texture_video. Replaces the FUN_140677a10 (foam_particle) attempt whose readback was hardcoded to sampler unit 3.
